evidence: Matches 'Wallet' label and modifies wallet coin selection logic in `src/wallet/spend.cpp` and `src/wallet/types.h`.
rationale: Fixes inaccurate tracepoint reporting and avoids redundant coin selection passes when partial spends are already absent. Issue #25150 notes that 'Coin Selection tracepoint overreports use of APS' because the wallet unconditionally runs and reports the grouped pass even if ungrouped selection left no partial spend to avoid.
